name: find_elements
description: Finds UI elements in a window by name, role or automation id and returns their ids plus a snapshot_id for click_element or type_text; reports ambiguous matches explicitly.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive part of the element name.

count.description: Wait until exactly this many elements match; timeout_ms bounds the wait.

node.description: Registered node identifier; URLs are not accepted.

visible.description: Restrict to the observed visibility state. Re-observe before input; this filter is not a focus or OS security boundary.

enabled.description: Restrict to the observed enabled state.

within.description: Search only below the one element matching this role and name.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive part of the container name.
